working: The order follows the historical experiments. Priestley (1770s) used a bell jar, candle and mouse to show the role of air. Ingenhousz showed that green parts release oxygen in sunlight. Sachs (1854) showed glucose is produced, stored as starch. Engelmann's prism experiment was the forerunner of the absorption/action spectra for chlorophyll a and b, which came later. So: role of air → release of oxygen → production of glucose → absorption spectra.
